measurement_contract.callback: InputService::mouse QPC after code<0/instance guard through its final QPC, excluding downstream CallNextHookEx and excluding recording overhead after that final QPC. Elapsed wall-clock time includes possible thread scheduling/preemption; these summaries cannot attribute a slow sample to a branch or prove its cause.
measurement_contract.callback_distribution_limit: Only p99 bucket and maximum were serialized. Exact callback min/median/p95/p99 and per-event sample identities are unavailable; none are invented.
measurement_contract.callback_bucket_basis: Frozen source src/core/v1/timing_histogram.h uses inclusive microsecond upper bounds [...,999,1000,2000,...], ceil(QPC delta * 1e6/frequency), and returns the FIRST bucket whose cumulative count reaches ceil(n*p/100). With saturation=false and a final joined producer, p99 bucket2000 therefore places the rank in (1000,2000] rounded microseconds, not merely under an uninformative upper bound. This proves failure of the <1000us target in those measured runs; it does not establish a system/root cause or a host usability verdict.
measurement_contract.placement: (post_observed_qpc - hook_observed_qpc)/10000 milliseconds, one sample per actual native placement. Multiple group members may share one hook timestamp and remain distinct placement samples. This is software-observed input-to-postverify, not physical input-to-display latency or the duration of every motion quantum.
measurement_contract.native_API: (native_after_qpc - native_before_qpc)/10000 milliseconds. API elapsed time is distinct from queue/admission/postverify time and does not prove compositor presentation.
measurement_contract.statistics: Arithmetic median (average of two middle values for even n); p95 uses sorted element ceil(0.95*n), 1-based. Raw QPC deltas are used for exact derived placement metrics; the existing in-product histogram rounds UP to integer microseconds and reports conservative bucket upper bounds.
measurement_contract.excluded_from_exact_placement_distributi: No-op/no-native receipts; unknown completion until an actual correlated completion is observed; missing/zero/reversed endpoints. Delayed completion is correlated only by the same process and call_id. No final successful sample is silently substituted for an unknown one.
